title: The Little Mermaid (The Soul of the Sea)

full_text:
In the sapphire depths of the ocean abyss, where coral branches bloom and pearls carpet the seafloor, the youngest daughter of the Sea King yearned for the higher world of humans and the eternal soul that outlives the ocean tide.

She gave up her melodious voice, endured the agony of walking upon razor-sharp blades, and watched in silent silence as the prince she had rescued from shipwreck wedded another. Yet when her sorrowing mermaid sisters brought the enchanted dagger of the Sea Witch, commanding her to slay the prince to reclaim her ocean life, the little mermaid refused to let hatred or self-preservation stain her love.

She kissed the sleeping prince's brow, hurled the murderous blade into the foaming breakers, and leaped into the deep.

Instead of dissolving into cold sea foam, her selfless sacrifice lifted her into the radiant company of the Daughters of the Air. Through three centuries of silent deeds of mercy and comfort to crying children, she was granted the eternal path to the Kingdom of Heaven—proving that love which gives all without demand receives everlasting life.
moral: Love that surrenders all possessiveness transcends mortal limits to achieve immortal glory.
